current.headline: Phase 18 local acceptance complete — production action gated
current.summary: The owner-scoped RAG index, persistent streamed conversations, retrieval-first cited answers, and responsive reader chat pass local acceptance. The feature, provider-answer path, and automatic embedding path all fail closed by default; no production migration, deployment, or paid canary has been performed.
current.nextAction: Await explicit owner direction before any production migration, feature enablement, deployment, or paid provider verification. Keep Phase 18's local implementation and licensing boundary intact.
